summary: Verified the cover-image regen fixes end-to-end: (1) GenerateImageBody body-parsing regression FIXED — sending {prompt:'X'} now persists image_prompt='X' on the post (Pydantic ForwardRef bug from nested-class default is resolved by moving to module-level + Body(default_factory=...)); (2) Logo re-compositing works on EVERY generation path (first-time, regenerate-with-override, regenerate-empty-body) — composed-*.png files emitted with with_logo=True; (3) Frontend hover overlays (Pencil + Download) render top-right of post cover image with opacity 0→1 on hover, action-row Download button uses post.text slug filename (not UUID); (4) rehydrate_autopost_jobs no longer crashes on tz-naive datetimes — backend log shows 'Rehydrated 1 autopost jobs' clean. 7/7 backend pytest passing.

rca of the issue: Original bug RCA: GenerateImageBody was defined as a nested class inside the registration function and the endpoint used `body: GenerateImageBody = GenerateImageBody()` as default. Pydantic resolved this annotation as ForwardRef('GenerateImageBody') in the FastAPI dependency-injection layer, but the inner class wasn't visible at the point of resolution → TypeAdapter failed with 'not fully defined' OR (worse) silently bound an empty default, dropping the JSON body. Fix: hoist GenerateImageBody to module scope (line 76) + use FastAPI's Body(default_factory=GenerateImageBody) so default is constructed lazily by the framework. Verified by test_custom_prompt_persists_image_prompt — image_prompt now correctly round-trips.
